reserveReview.rationale: The exact contract is Morpho Vault V2, not MetaMorpho V1. At Ethereum block 26095798, asset() returned USDC and its sole listed adapter and liquidityAdapter() were 0x2b9681015a1fa2225d1fc8ae40538d3d64c58290, whose verified source is MorphoMarketV1AdapterV2. The deployed exposure remains a USDC-denominated protocol position with borrower-collateral, curator, liquidity, and smart-contract risk. This identity correction does not re-date the historical composition snapshot.
